paper_id: RL-PLUS_ Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
title: RL-PLUS: Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
motivation: 当前RLVR方法只能进行内化利用(on-policy)，无法突破基座模型的能力边界，导致能力边界崩塌
problem_framing: RLVR的pass@128显著低于基座模型，说明其收窄了模型的解空间；SFT+GRPO简单组合因KL约束导致负迁移
key_insight: 用Multiple Importance Sampling处理外部数据分布偏移，用Exploration-Based Advantage Function优先学习低概率但正确的推理路径
method_signature: 混合策略优化：内化利用(GRPO) + 外部探索(MIS + EBAF)，去除clipping机制
evaluation_criteria: Pass@k曲线超越基座模型、6个数学推理benchmark平均提升5.2分、 entropy不崩塌
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: GRPO w/ SFT Loss (简单相加SFT loss) 反而降低性能，说明有效融合两种学习范式是 nontrivial 的挑战
evidence_for_taste: collapsed the base model's capability boundary
hard to continuous 'learning' of new knowledge
effective integration is a non-trivial challenge
RLVR refines the probability of known correct paths but fails to expand the overall set of solvable problems
The entropy of RL-PLUS does not diminish to zero
prioritizes novel yet high-value reasoning paths
thinking_moves: 把LLM的RLVR问题类比到教育学古训'学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆'
用Pass@k vs Pass@1的差距来定义能力边界崩塌
从信息论角度分析on-policy IS的bias和off-policy IS的variance explosion
把行为策略估计建模为贝叶斯决策问题：在已知代理πθ_old和最大不确定性(均匀分布)之间做最优权衡
借鉴focal loss思想设计exploration weight：低概率正确token获得更大梯度信号
证明MIS estimator的方差鲁棒性：只要行为池中有一个好的策略，estimator就低方差
